_source: CBS league scoring settings, screenshotted by Angelo 2026-08-07.
_eventNote: Forced fumble (1) is scored SEPARATELY from the recovery (3), so a fumble the defense forces and recovers is worth 4, not 3. INT and fumble recovery are both 3 — CBS default is 2. Yards allowed scores ZERO in this league.
_multiplierNote: SET TO 1.0 DELIBERATELY. RPB achieves its doubled D/ST scoring through inflated category values (INT and fumble recovery at 3 rather than 2, points-allowed tiers running to +20) rather than a literal 2x. The app's dstMult:2 shortcut approximated this. Applying a multiplier on top of these settings would double-count.
_tierWarning: The tiers are PER GAME and the steps are large — 10-13 PA scores 10 while 14-20 scores 8 and 21-27 only 4. Scoring a season from an AVERAGE points-allowed understates the value of a volatile defense that posts shutouts. Treat season totals as indicative of order, not exact.
